verdict.rationale: GA4 documents exporting all raw events to BigQuery, with a full daily export plus continuous intra-day export, so they can be queried with SQL and joined with external data (docs-31, docs-32, docs-33, docs-34). BigQuery links can also be managed via the Admin API (docs-20), and a community user confirms the BigQuery hookup is easy and cheap (comm-16). Missing for 10: export destinations other than BigQuery (e.g. Snowflake/Redshift), in-product querying of warehouse tables, and a non-alpha bigQueryLinks API.
